Game Overview

In Tartarus Dice & Delves, the core idea is straightforward: descend into the shadows of Tartarus Dice, where each roll of the dice could lead to triumph or doom. Upgrade your hero, uncover rare treasures, and fight formidable creatures. Face the ultimate challenge against the Four Legendary Bosses in this dungeon crawler adventure. Will fate favor you?

How to Play

The moment-to-moment gameplay in Tartarus Dice & Delves is easy to pick up. Descend into the shadows of Tartarus Dice, where each roll of the dice could lead to triumph or doom.
